title: U.S Department of the Interior Unstable Slope Management Program stores local user passwords as… (CVE-2026-129178)
description: The U.S Department of the Interior Unstable Slope Management Program was found to store local user passwords as unsalted MD5 hashes, a weak and outdated hashing method. This vulnerability was fixed on or around October 19, 2026. The CVSS score is 6.5, indicating a medium severity issue with network attack vector and low attack complexity. The flaw allows an attacker with local privileges to obtain password hashes that could be more easily cracked due to the lack of salting.
